d:
Watch Aye Sinamika from O Kadhal Kanmani. Sung by Karthik with lyrics by Vairamuthu, A.R. Rahman gives this love song a twist that will leave you liking it even more.
Song Name - Aye Sinamika
Movie - O Kadhal Kanmani
Singer - Karthik
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Vairamuthu
Director - Mani Ratnam
Starring - Dulquer Salmaan, Nithya Menen
